name: Knee raise
movement: one knee lifted to a right angle and held

phone.placement: Stand the phone up on the floor, leaning on something, two or three metres away, side on to where you will be.

words.hint: Phone standing up, side on to you, whole body in frame.
words.start: Stand the phone up on the floor, then stand side on, tall, and raise one knee.
words.position: Stand side on to the phone, tall, feet together, arms relaxed at your sides.
words.top: One knee up with the thigh level and the knee at a right angle, foot relaxed under it.
howto: Stand tall, weight on one foot.
Raise the other knee until the thigh is level and the knee is at a right angle, foot relaxed under it.
Hold at the top for the count; keep the standing leg and the trunk still.
Lower slowly and put the foot down — the rep counts when you are standing again.
words.cannot: The standing side and the hips staying level: it follows the raised leg nearest the camera. Balance is yours.
words.about: Knee raise — standing side on, tall, one knee up: the angle at that knee between hip and ankle, and the angle at its heel between the toe and the knee, the first allowed 80–100° and the second 60–100°. Hold ten seconds, lower slowly, and the rep counts when you are back to standing.
words.lost: Step into the camera, side on
words.early: Hold it to the end of the count next time
words.safety: Hold something for balance if you need to; the camera does not mind a hand on a chair.
words.easier: A shorter hold; a hand on a wall.
words.harder: A longer hold; an ankle weight; eyes closed.
words.mistakes: Leaning back to lift the knee; the foot pointing down; the knee not coming up to level.

measurements.label: knee angle
measurements.why: A right angle at the raised knee, ten degrees either way.

measurements.label: toe, heel, knee
measurements.why: The foot's own line against the shin's, taken at the heel. It grows as the toes point away and shrinks as they come up. The band is not centred on a right angle and is not meant to be.

measurements.label: thigh from straight down
measurements.why: 0 standing, 90 thigh level. Not judged: it tells the phases apart and picks the leg being raised.

faults.label: Knee too open
faults.deep: Bend your knee to a right angle

faults.label: Knee too closed
faults.deep: Open your knee out to a right angle

faults.label: Foot pointing away
faults.deep: Pull your toes up — your foot is pointing away

faults.label: Toes pulled up
faults.deep: Ease your toes down — your toes are pulled too far up

settings.label: Thigh angle that counts as raised
